name: TokenizerRules
signature: public sealed partial class TokenizerRules<TKind> where TKind : unmanaged, Enum

docs.summary: Declarative, fluent configuration for a [`Tokenizer<TKind>`](#api~Prowl.Crumb.Tokenizer). Register whitespace handling, fixed tokens (keywords/symbols), dynamic rules, comments and embedded blocks, then hand the compiled object to a tokenizer. The same rules object is immutable once compiled and may be reused across many tokenizers.

members.name: Identifier
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> Identifier(TKind kind, CharPredicate? start = null, CharPredicate? part = null)

docs.summary: Adds an identifier rule. `start` recognises the first character; `part` recognises continuation characters. The continuation predicate is also used for keyword word-boundary checks.
Adds a number rule supporting integers, decimals, scientific notation and hexadecimal literals (0x...).

members.name: String
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> String(char delimiter, TKind kind, char escape = '\\')

docs.summary: Adds a string rule delimited by `delimiter`. Characters following `escape` are taken literally. An unterminated string consumes to end of input.

members.name: Comment
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> Comment(string open, string close)

docs.summary: Registers a comment that is skipped (not emitted as a token). Everything from `open` up to and including `close` is ignored.

members.name: Comment
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> Comment(string open, string close, TKind kind)

docs.summary: Registers a comment that is emitted as a token of the given kind. The token spans the delimiters and the content between them.
Registers a single-line comment running from `prefix` to the end of the line. The comment is skipped and not emitted as a token.

members.name: LineComment
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> LineComment(string prefix, TKind kind)

docs.summary: Registers a single-line comment running from `prefix` to the end of the line, emitted as a token of the given kind. The terminating newline is not part of the token.
Configures the predicate used to recognise (and skip) whitespace.
The token kind emitted when the end of the source is reached.
The token kind emitted for a character that no rule could consume.

members.name: Symbol
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> Symbol(string text, TKind kind)

docs.summary: Registers a symbol: a fixed string matched literally with no word-boundary requirement. Longest match wins, so registering both "=" and "==" resolves greedily to "==".

members.name: Keyword
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> Keyword(string text, TKind kind)

docs.summary: Registers a keyword: a fixed string that only matches when not immediately followed by an identifier-continuation character, so "Shader" will not match inside "Shaders".

members.name: Block
members.signature: public TokenizerRules<TKind> Block(string open, string close, TKind kind)

docs.summary: Registers an opaque block. After the opening string is matched, the tokenizer scans forward to the closing string and emits a single token spanning the content between them, without tokenizing the embedded language.
Registers a custom dynamic rule. Rules run in registration order.
Compiles the registrations into fast dispatch tables. Idempotent.
